applies_why: The judge text rules on whether Jeremiah 22:30 is counted against a link, which is the counting question K-G4 governs.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge says the pressed curse limb was dropped and no live link remains to contradict, so it is not counting the verse toward a broken link, and not counting it obeys K-G4.
